announcement.quote: Nuveen Churchill Private Capital Income Fund (“PCAP”) and Nuveen Churchill Private Credit Fund (“NCPCF”) today announced that they have entered into a purchase and sale agreement pursuant to which NCPCF will sell to PCAP substantially all of its assets, PCAP will assume NCPCF’s liabilities

outcome_evidence.quote: On December 11, 2024, Nuveen Churchill Private Capital Income Fund, a Delaware statutory trust (the “PCAP”), completed its previously announced acquisition of substantially all of the assets of Nuveen Churchill Private Credit Fund (the “Fund”), a Delaware statutory trust (the “Transaction”).

deals.notes: Structured as a sale of substantially all NCPCF assets to PCAP for cash equal to NAV, followed by NCPCF winding down, not a share-for-share merger. NCPCF's 8-K cover lists no exchange or trading symbol, so the pair is not listed. The transaction was completed on 2024-12-11 after shareholder approval on 2024-12-05 (8-K 0001628280-24-050351).
